What this data cannot tell you

Public production supports statistical observations, not an uplift promise. Reservoir depletion versus mechanical failure cannot be distinguished from rate data alone; each candidate requires operating records and diagnostics. Lease totals cannot be interpreted as individual-well production. Operator of record does not establish ownership or working interest. Inventory differences can reflect reporting dates, transfers or status changes. Specific uplift, economics and working interest are NOT_EVALUATED.

False-positive rate: NOT_EVALUATED (validation evidence not captured)
